examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎoshì, měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng. Jīntiān de kǎoshì bù nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de búcuò.
examples.english: There will be an exam tomorrow, so every student is very nervous. Today's exam was not difficult; everyone did pretty well on the test.

examples.chinese: 明天有書法課，我要帶毛筆去學校。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu shūfǎ kè, wǒ yào dài máobǐ qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: Tomorrow there is calligraphy class; I need to bring a brush to school.

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 你可以告訴我學中文的經驗嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gàosu wǒ xué Zhōngwén de jīngyàn ma?
examples.english: Can you tell me about your experience learning Chinese?

examples.chinese: 你要參加學校的游泳比賽嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào cānjiā xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài ma?
examples.english: Are you going to participate in the school's swimming competition?

examples.chinese: 考試開始以後，我們不可以跟同學說話。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ yǐhòu, wǒmen bù kěyǐ gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
examples.english: After the exam starts, we cannot talk with classmates.

examples.chinese: 你這學期的成績進步了，太好了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqī de chéngjī jìnbù le, tài hǎo le!
examples.english: Your grades this semester have improved; that's great!

examples.chinese: 他的父母都在學校當老師。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fùmǔ dōu zài xuéxiào dāng lǎoshī.
examples.english: His parents both work as teachers at a school.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛在學校附近看到中明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng zài xuéxiào fùjìn kàndào Zhōngmíng.
examples.english: I just now saw Zhongming near the school.

examples.chinese: 學校的網站上有很多學生寫的文章。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng yǒu hěn duō xuéshēng xiě de wénzhāng.
examples.english: On the school's website there are many articles written by students.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 我同學送了我一張電影票，可是我沒有空去看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué sòng le wǒ yì zhāng diànyǐng piào, kěshì wǒ méiyǒu kòng qù kàn.
examples.english: My classmate gave me a movie ticket, but I don't have time to go see it.

examples.chinese: 這幾個數學問題我都不懂，不知道怎麼算。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge shùxué wèntí wǒ dōu bù dǒng, bù zhīdào zěnme suàn.
examples.english: I don't understand any of these math problems; I don't know how to calculate them.

examples.chinese: 語言和科學我都很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yǔyán hé kēxué wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: I like both language and science.

examples.chinese: 明天晚上學校有一個新年晚會，你會去參加嗎？
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu yī gè xīnnián wǎnhuì, nǐ huì qù cānjiā ma?
examples.english: Tomorrow evening the school has a New Year evening event, will you go to participate?

examples.chinese: 他住的那棟大樓附近有學校，也有餐廳。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù de nà dòng dàlóu fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yě yǒu cāntīng.
examples.english: Near the building where he lives there is a school, and also a restaurant.

examples.chinese: 大家都歡迎新老師到我們學校來。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huānyíng xīn lǎoshī dào wǒmen xuéxiào lái.
examples.english: Everyone welcomes the new teacher to come to our school.

examples.chinese: A:我覺得語言比數學有趣多了？ B:我同意你說的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde yǔyán bǐ shùxué yǒuqù duō le? B: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ shuō de.
examples.english: A: I think languages are much more interesting than math? B: I agree with what you said.

examples.chinese: 我們今天要學第十五課，老師會給我們介紹十二生肖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, lǎoshī huì gěi wǒmen jièshào shí'èr shēngxiào.
examples.english: Today we are going to study Lesson 15; the teacher will introduce the twelve zodiac signs to us.

examples.chinese: 同學們，現在請打開課本，我們看第十五課。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen, xiànzài qǐng dǎkāi kèběn, wǒmen kàn dì shíwǔ kè.
examples.english: Classmates, now please open your textbooks; we are looking at Lesson 15.

examples.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 他手裡拿著禮物，在學校門口等著女朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe lǐwù, zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děngzhe nǚpéngyǒu.
examples.english: He is holding a gift in his hand and is waiting for his girlfriend at the school entrance.

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 我們從小學到大學都是同學，也是很好的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng xiǎoxué dào dàxué dōu shì tóngxué, yě shì hěn hǎo de péngyǒu.
examples.english: From elementary school to university, we have always been classmates and also very good friends.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟是小學四年級的學生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi shì xiǎoxué sì niánjí de xuéshēng.
examples.english: My younger brother is a fourth-grade elementary school student.

examples.chinese: 我每天上學以前，一定先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shàngxué yǐqián, yídìng xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Every day before I go to school, I always eat breakfast at home first.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 孔先生學法律，不但是為了當好律師，也是為了保護家人。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānsheng xué fǎlǜ, bùdàn shì wèile dāng hǎo lǜshī, yě shì wèile bǎohù jiārén.
examples.english: Mr. Kong studies law not only to become a good lawyer but also to protect his family.

examples.chinese: 追求學問就是要多用腦，不斷地學，不斷地問。
examples.pinyin: Zhuīqiú xuéwèn jiùshì yào duō yòng nǎo, bùduàn de xué, bùduàn de wèn.
examples.english: Pursuing learning means using your brain more, constantly learning, and constantly asking questions.

examples.chinese: 想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.
examples.english: If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources.

examples.chinese: 沒有人能保證上了有名的大學，未來就一定快樂、幸福。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén néng bǎozhèng shàngle yǒumíng de dàxué, wèilái jiù yīdìng kuàilè, xìngfú.
examples.english: No one can guarantee that if you get into a famous university, you will definitely be happy and blessed in the future.

examples.chinese: 謝先生是從很有名的學校畢業的，但是聽說因為吃不了苦，什麼工作都做得不久。
examples.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng shì cóng hěn yǒumíng de xuéxiào bìyè de, dànshì tīngshuō yīnwèi chī bùliǎo kǔ, shénme gōngzuò dōu zuò de bùjiǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Xie graduated from a very famous school, but I heard that because he can't endure hardship, he doesn't last long at any job.

examples.chinese: 大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。
examples.pinyin: Dàwěi tǐng xǐhuān tā xiànzài de gōngzuò, bùdàn néng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yě néng xuéxí xīn de dōngxi.
examples.english: Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lǐtáng kàn qǐlái kōngjiān bú dà, qíshí zuò de xià yì qiān rén.
examples.english: Our school's auditorium looks like it doesn't have much space, but actually it can seat a thousand people.

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 外國學生一開始學寫漢字的速度比較慢，只要多練習就能越寫越快了。
examples.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng yī kāishǐ xué xiě Hànzì de sùdù bǐjiào màn, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù néng yuè xiě yuè kuài le.
examples.english: Foreign students' speed at writing Chinese characters is relatively slow at first; as long as they practice more, they will be able to write faster and faster.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 這所大學有最新的電腦設備，提供學生很好的學習環境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǒu zuìxīn de diànnǎo shèbèi, tígōng xuéshēng hěn hǎo de xuéxí huánjìng.
examples.english: This university has the latest computer equipment, providing students with a very good learning environment.

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Chén lǎoshī wèile yǐnqǐ xuéshēng de xuéxí xìngqù, měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì zhǔnbèi yīxiē yǒuqù de yóuxì.
examples.english: In order to arouse the students' interest in learning, Teacher Chen prepares some interesting games before every class.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 許多青少年為了考上好學校，不得不犧牲假日去補習。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qīngshàonián wèile kǎo shàng hǎo xuéxiào, bùdébù xīshēng jiàrì qù bǔxí.
examples.english: Many teenagers, in order to get into a good school, have no choice but to sacrifice their holidays to go to cram school.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我過得很充實，不但完成了期末報告，還跟同學去游泳、衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ guò de hěn chōngshí, búdàn wánchéng le qīmò bàogào, hái gēn tóngxué qù yóuyǒng, chōnglàng.
examples.english: This weekend I had a very full time—not only did I finish my final report, but I also went swimming and surfing with classmates.

examples.chinese: 為了偏僻地區孩子的教育，有十幾位老師願意上山下海，到山上、海邊的學校教書。
examples.pinyin: Wèile piānpì dìqū háizi de jiàoyù, yǒu shí jǐ wèi lǎoshī yuànyì shàngshānxiàhǎi, dào shānshàng, hǎibiān de xuéxiào jiāoshū.
examples.english: For the education of children in remote areas, more than ten teachers are willing to go everywhere, to schools in the mountains and by the sea, to teach.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 我到德國留學的頭兩個星期，因為對環境不環境而迷過幾次路，後來就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào Déguó liúxué de tóu liǎng gè xīngqī, yīnwèi duì huánjìng bù shúxī ér mí guò jǐ cì lù, hòulái jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: In the first two weeks of studying in Germany, because I was not familiar with the environment, I got lost a few times; later there was no problem.

examples.chinese: 東西方的文化差異很大，像穿著、音樂、哲學等風格都不相同。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì hěn dà, xiàng chuānzhuó, yīnyuè, zhéxué děng fēnggé dōu bù xiāngtóng.
examples.english: The cultural differences between East and West are great; styles such as apparel, music, and philosophy are all different.

examples.chinese: 去年生日爸爸送了我一輛自行車，從那天起，我就天天騎著它去上學。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián shēngrì bàba sòng le wǒ yī liàng zìxíngchē, cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù tiāntiān qí zhe tā qù shàngxué.
examples.english: Last year on my birthday, Dad gave me a bicycle; from that day on, I have ridden it to school every day.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 我今天跟同學穿了樣式不同，但是顏色相同的洋裝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān gēn tóngxué chuān le yàngshì bùtóng, dànshì yánsè xiāngtóng de yángzhuāng.
examples.english: Today my classmate and I wore dresses that are different in style but the same in color.

examples.chinese: 老師認為這個問題很難，只有一個學生回答得很正確，所以給他加了一些分數。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi zhège wèntí hěn nán, zhǐyǒu yí ge xuésheng huídá de hěn zhèngquè, suǒyǐ gěi tā jiā le yìxiē fēnshù.
examples.english: The teacher thought this question was very difficult, and only one student answered very correctly, so he gave him some extra points.

examples.chinese: 今天的數學考試我只考了三十分，要是被爸爸知道，他一定會罵我的。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de shùxué kǎoshì wǒ zhǐ kǎo le sānshí fēn, yàoshi bèi bàba zhīdào, tā yídìng huì mà wǒ de.
examples.english: I only scored 30 on today’s math test; if my dad finds out, he will definitely scold me.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 我同學記筆記的速度很快，也記得很清楚，所以我常跟他借筆記來複習功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué jì bǐjì de sùdù hěn kuài, yě jì de hěn qīngchu, suǒyǐ wǒ cháng gēn tā jiè bǐjì lái fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: My classmate takes notes very quickly and also remembers them very clearly, so I often borrow his notes to review my lessons.

examples.chinese: 這個學期中文課的新教材是時代華語第三冊，一共有十六課。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī Zhōngwén kè de xīn jiàocái shì Shídài Huáyǔ dì-sān cè, yígòng yǒu shíliù kè.
examples.english: This semester’s new Chinese course teaching material is Modern Chinese Volume 3, which has sixteen lessons in total.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 這堂語法課的內容比較難，學生有任何問題都可以舉手請教老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng yǔfǎ kè de nèiróng bǐjiào nán, xuéshēng yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī.
examples.english: The content of this grammar class is relatively difficult; students can raise their hands to ask the teacher for advice if they have any questions.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: A:你知道辦理留學的手續需要準備哪些資料嗎？ B:我不清楚。你可以上網查查。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhīdào bànlǐ liúxué de shǒuxù xūyào zhǔnbèi nǎxiē zīliào ma? B: Wǒ bù qīngchu. Nǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng cháchá.
examples.english: A: Do you know what materials need to be prepared to deal with the procedures for studying abroad? B: I'm not sure. You can look it up online.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 出國當交換學生的目的，不僅僅是為了學習語言，更重要的是了解當地的文化。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó dāng jiāohuàn xuéshēng de mùdì, bù jǐnjǐn shì wèile xuéxí yǔyán, gèng zhòngyào de shì liǎojiě dāngdì de wénhuà.
examples.english: The purpose of going abroad as an exchange student is not merely to study a language; more importantly, it is to understand the local culture.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.
examples.english: Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper.

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shùnlì tōngguò le dàxué kǎoshì, jīnnián jiù shì yī niánjí de xīnshēng le.
examples.english: Xiaoming successfully passed the university exam; this year he is a freshman.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 畢業當天，許多學生帶著攝影機在校園裡攝影，留下了珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè dāngtiān, xǔduō xuéshēng dài zhe shèyǐngjī zài xiàoyuán lǐ shèyǐng, liú xià le zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: On graduation day, many students brought cameras and took pictures on campus, leaving behind precious memories.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
examples.pinyin: Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.
examples.english: That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture.

examples.chinese: 想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin: 1. Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí. 2. Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le. 3. Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english: 1. Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling. 2. Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires. 3. Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 他努力了三年，終於考上了最好的大學，他激動得流下了眼淚。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì le sān nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng le zuì hǎo de dàxué, tā jīdòng de liú xià le yǎnlèi.
examples.english: He worked hard for three years and finally got into the best university; he was so excited that he shed tears.

examples.chinese: 付完學費，我的獎學金只剩下三千塊，這個月只有吃饅頭過日子了。
examples.pinyin: Fù wán xuéfèi, wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn zhǐ shèng xià sānqiān kuài, zhège yuè zhǐyǒu chī mántou guò rìzi le.
examples.english: After paying the tuition, I only have 3000 dollars of my scholarship left; this month I can only live on steamed buns.

examples.chinese: 小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng xǐhuan yuèdú Fǎguó de wénxué zuòpǐn, tòuguò zhèxiē zuòpǐn, ràng tā liǎojiě le Fǎguó wénhuà de tèsè.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang likes to read French literary works; through these works, he has come to understand the characteristics of French culture.

examples.chinese: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.
examples.english: The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xuéxiào quēfá jīngfèi, sùshè de diànnǎo shèbèi zànshí méi bànfǎ gǎishàn.
examples.english: Because the school lacks funds, the computer equipment in the dormitory cannot be improved for the time being.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 上帝是不是存在，這是屬於宗教領域的問題，科學家的解釋不一定是正確的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngdì shì bú shì cúnzài, zhè shì shǔyú zōngjiào lǐngyù de wèntí, kēxuéjiā de jiěshì bù yídìng shì zhèngquè de.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not is a question that belongs to the religious field; scientists' explanations are not necessarily correct.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 王伯伯最近很得意，到處告訴鄰居他兒子考上了全國最有名的大學。
examples.pinyin: Wáng bóbo zuìjìn hěn déyì, dàochù gàosù línjū tā érzi kǎo shàng le quánguó zuì yǒumíng de dàxué.
examples.english: Uncle Wang has been very proud of himself recently, telling neighbors everywhere that his son has been admitted to the most famous university in the country.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 這課真的不好學。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè zhēnde bù hǎo xué.
examples.english: This chapter is really difficult to learn.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 最近我的台灣朋友想學日文，請我教他，我也請他教我中文。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ de Táiwān péngyǒu xiǎng xué Rìwén, qǐng wǒ jiāo tā, wǒ yě qǐng tā jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.
examples.english: These days, one of my Taiwanese friends wants to learn Japanese. He asked me to teach him Japanese, so I asked him to teach me Chinese as well.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

items.wordHook: Two 𦥑(hands) over a desk 冖(cover) guide counting 爻(crossed sticks) for an eager 子(child) to 學(learn).

examples.chinese: 在這個大車站，坐公車、捷運、火車都很方便。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège dà chēzhàn, zuò gōngchē, jiéyùn, huǒchē dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: At this big station, taking the bus, MRT, or train is all very convenient.

examples.chinese: 火車應該快到了，我們去前面排隊吧。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē yīnggāi kuài dào le, wǒmen qù qiánmiàn páiduì ba.
examples.english: The train should be arriving soon; let's go line up in front.

examples.chinese: 週末到花蓮的火車票一下子就賣光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò dào Huālián de huǒchēpiào yīxiàzi jiù mài guāng le.
examples.english: Weekend train tickets to Hualien sold out in an instant.

examples.chinese: 我要搭火車去東部，座位是3車16號。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dā huǒchē qù dōngbù, zuòwèi shì sān chē shíliù hào.
examples.english: I'm going to take the train to the east; my seat is car 3, number 16.

examples.chinese: 搭火車的時候，我喜歡坐在窗戶旁邊的位子，邊聽音樂邊看風景。
examples.pinyin: Dā huǒchē de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuān zuò zài chuānghu pángbiān de wèizi, biān tīng yīnyuè biān kàn fēngjǐng.
examples.english: When taking the train, I like to sit in a seat by the window, listening to music while looking at the scenery.

examples.chinese: 到東部的火車票很難訂，我訂了好幾次才成功。這次社區的中秋節活動辦得很成功，大家都玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Dào dōngbù de huǒchēpiào hěn nán dìng, wǒ dìng le hǎojǐ cì cái chénggōng. Zhè cì shèqū de zhōngqiūjié huódòng bàn de hěn chénggōng, dàjiā dōu wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Tickets for trains to the east are hard to book; I tried several times before succeeding. This time the community's Mid-Autumn Festival event was very successful, and everyone had a great time.

examples.chinese: 週末的時候，火車站的賣票窗口總是排滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, huǒchēzhàn de mài piào chuāngkǒu zǒngshì pái mǎn le rén.
examples.english: On weekends, the ticket windows at the train station are always fully lined up with people.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，退火車票得早一點兒，越晚退的話，扣的錢也越多。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, tuì huǒchē piào děi zǎo yīdiǎnr, yuè wǎn tuì de huà, kòu de qián yě yuè duō.
examples.english: In Taiwan, you have to return train tickets early; the later you return them, the more money is deducted.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，上網訂好火車票後，可選擇到車站或便利商店取票。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shàngwǎng dìng hǎo huǒchē piào hòu, kě xuǎnzé dào chēzhàn huò biànlì shāngdiàn qǔ piào.
examples.english: In Taiwan, after booking train tickets online, you can choose to pick up the tickets at the station or at a convenience store.

examples.chinese: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
examples.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē shí, yīpáng de lǚkè bùtíng de jiǎng diànhuà, chǎo de wǒ shòubuliǎo.
examples.english: When I was on the train, the passenger beside me kept talking on the phone, making such a noise that I couldn't stand it.

items.wordHook: 火(fire) + 車(vehicle) → the fire-powered vehicle: 火車 is a train.

examples.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
examples.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

examples.chinese: 我去樓下的超市買點菜，待會兒做些家鄉菜給你嘗嘗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù lóuxià de chāoshì mǎi diǎn cài, dàihuìr zuò xiē jiāxiāng cài gěi nǐ chángchang.
examples.english: I'm going to the supermarket downstairs to buy some groceries; in a moment I'll cook some hometown dishes for you to try.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳，沒有人替你服務，點菜、拿碗筷等一切都得自助。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng, méiyǒu rén tì nǐ fúwù, diǎncài, ná wǎnkuài děng yīqiè dōu děi zìzhù.
examples.english: In this restaurant, no one serves you; ordering dishes, getting bowls and chopsticks, and everything else must be self-service.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.chinese: 算起來我們已經好久沒吃餃子了，買點兒麵粉、青菜和肉，回家包餃子吧。
examples.pinyin: Suàn qǐlái wǒmen yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi chī jiǎozi le, mǎi diǎnr miànfěn, qīngcài hé ròu, huí jiā bāo jiǎozi ba.
examples.english: Counting it up, we haven't eaten dumplings for a long time; let's buy some flour, vegetables, and meat, and go home to make dumplings.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟是小學四年級的學生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi shì xiǎoxué sì niánjí de xuéshēng.
examples.english: My younger brother is a fourth-grade elementary school student.

examples.chinese: 林老師在日文系教書，他教的是二年級的日語會話。
examples.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī zài Rìwén xì jiāoshū, tā jiāo de shì èr niánjí de Rìyǔ huìhuà.
examples.english: Teacher Lin teaches in the Japanese department; what he teaches is second-year Japanese conversation.

examples.chinese: 小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shùnlì tōngguò le dàxué kǎoshì, jīnnián jiù shì yī niánjí de xīnshēng le.
examples.english: Xiaoming successfully passed the university exam; this year he is a freshman.

examples.chinese: 第一次約會的時候，林先生感覺(到)自己很緊張。這棟公寓除了環境不錯，家具還很新，感覺住起來會很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì yuēhuì de shíhou, Lín xiānsheng gǎnjué (dào) zìjǐ hěn jǐnzhāng. Zhè dòng gōngyù chúle huánjìng búcuò, jiājù hái hěn xīn, gǎnjué zhù qǐlái huì hěn shūfu.
examples.english: On their first date, Mr. Lin felt that he was very nervous. Besides having a nice environment, this apartment building also has very new furniture; it feels like it would be very comfortable to live in.

examples.chinese: 林明生躺在草地上看星星，他感覺真輕鬆。
examples.pinyin: Lín Míngshēng tǎng zài cǎodì shàng kàn xīngxing, tā gǎnjué zhēn qīngsōng.
examples.english: Lin Mingsheng lies on the grass looking at the stars; he feels truly relaxed.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上我發燒，燒到三十九度，那種感覺非常不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ fāshāo, shāo dào sānshíjiǔ dù, nà zhǒng gǎnjué fēicháng bù shūfu.
examples.english: Last night I had a fever that went up to thirty-nine degrees, and that feeling was extremely uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 這部愛情電影是根據真實故事拍出來的，看過的人都很有感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù àiqíng diànyǐng shì gēnjù zhēnshí gùshì pāi chūlái de, kànguò de rén dōu hěn yǒu gǎnjué.
examples.english: This romance movie was made according to a true story; everyone who has seen it feels deeply moved.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 彩色照片看起來很真實，不過黑白照片給人的感覺也很特別。
examples.pinyin: Cǎisè zhàopiàn kàn qǐlái hěn zhēnshí, bùguò hēibái zhàopiàn gěi rén de gǎnjué yě hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Color photos look very realistic, but black-and-white photos also give people a very special feeling.

examples.chinese: 公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de bùgào shàng tiēzhe chāoshì dǎzhé huódòng de guǎnggào, gǎnjué zhēn de hěn guài.
examples.english: The company's notice has an ad for a supermarket discount event posted on it; it feels really strange.

examples.chinese: 接觸陌生的事情及環境時，往往令人有點兒不安，這樣的感覺是很自然的。
examples.pinyin: Jiēchù mòshēng de shìqíng jí huánjìng shí, wǎngwǎng lìng rén yǒudiǎnr bù'ān, zhèyàng de gǎnjué shì hěn zìrán de.
examples.english: When coming into contact with unfamiliar things and environments, people often feel a bit uneasy; this feeling is very natural.

examples.chinese: 夏天運動過後，喝杯冰冰涼涼的冷飲，感覺很痛快。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yùndòng guò hòu, hē bēi bīngbīngliángliáng de lěngyǐn, gǎnjué hěn tòngkuài.
examples.english: After exercising in summer, drinking a glass of ice-cold cold drink feels very refreshing.

examples.chinese: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zài hùwài de yèjǐng zhōng shèyǐng, yǐ yuèguāng dāngzuò bèijǐng kě zēngjiā shénmì de gǎnjué.
examples.english: When photographing outdoor night scenes, using moonlight as the background can add a mysterious feeling.

examples.chinese: 平板越輕、功能越多，價格就越高。
examples.pinyin: Píngbǎn yuè qīng, gōngnéng yuè duō, jiàgé jiù yuè gāo.
examples.english: The lighter the tablet and the more functions it has, the higher the price.

examples.chinese: 筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

examples.chinese: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important.

examples.chinese: 我不認為地攤沒好貨，有一些地攤的東西不僅價格便宜，品質也不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú rènwéi dìtān méi hǎohuò, yǒu yìxiē dìtān de dōngxi bùjǐn jiàgé piányi, pǐnzhì yě búcuò.
examples.english: I don't think street stalls have no good goods; some stall items are not only cheap in price, but the quality is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
examples.pinyin: Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!
examples.english: Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 一般人認為，名牌商品不僅價格高，品質標準也比較高。「先有雞還是先有蛋」，這個問題有標準答案嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yìbān rén rènwéi, míngpái shāngpǐn bùjǐn jiàgé gāo, pǐnzhì biāozhǔn yě bǐjiào gāo. “Xiān yǒu jī háishì xiān yǒu dàn”, zhège wèntí yǒu biāozhǔn dá'àn ma?
examples.english: Most people think that brand-name products are not only high in price, but their quality standard is also relatively high. “Which came first, the chicken or the egg?” Does this question have a standard answer?

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǐpǐn diàn de shāngpǐn yàngshì bùcuò, bìngqiě jiàgé hélǐ, suǒyǐ shēngyì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That gift shop's product styles are quite good, and also the prices are reasonable, so business is very good.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
examples.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

examples.chinese: 我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā chūkǒu de nóngchǎnpǐn hěn yǒumíng, bùdàn jiàgé dī, pǐnzhì yòu hǎo.
examples.english: The agricultural products our country exports are very famous; not only is the price low, but the quality is also good.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 購買任何商品時都應考慮功能以及價格。
examples.pinyin: Gòumǎi rènhé shāngpǐn shí dōu yīng kǎolǜ gōngnéng yǐjí jiàgé.
examples.english: When purchasing any product, one should consider its functions as well as its price.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 這套陶瓷茶具是專家以手工方式做的，因此價格也不便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào táocí chájù shì zhuānjiā yǐ shǒugōng fāngshì zuò de, yīncǐ jiàgé yě bù piányí.
examples.english: This ceramic tea set was made by an expert by hand, so the price is not cheap either.

items.key: ["B3L01-1-44","别这么说","別這麼說","别这么说","Ph"]

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.
examples.english: That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful.

examples.chinese: 王老先生年輕時就離開了家鄉，他很想回老家去看看親人。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoxiānsheng niánqīng shí jiù líkāi le jiāxiāng, tā hěn xiǎng huí lǎojiā qù kànkan qīnrén.
examples.english: Mr. Wang left his hometown when he was young; he really wants to go back to his old home to see his relatives.

examples.chinese: 有人花大半輩子的時間工作，陪親人的時間卻非常少。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén huā dàbàn bèizi de shíjiān gōngzuò, péi qīnrén de shíjiān què fēicháng shǎo.
examples.english: Some people spend more than half their lifetime working, yet the time they spend with their family is very little.

examples.chinese: 弟弟感冒了，可是他不但不吃藥，還一連吃了三碗冰，結果咳嗽咳得越來越嚴重了。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi gǎnmào le, kěshì tā búdàn bù chī yào, hái yíliàn chī le sān wǎn bīng, jiéguǒ késou ké de yuèláiyuè yánzhòng le.
examples.english: My younger brother caught a cold, but not only did he not take medicine, he even ate three bowls of ice cream in a row; as a result, his cough became more and more serious.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 他把存了半輩子的錢都拿去做生意，結果生意不成功，錢都沒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ cún le bànbèizi de qián dōu ná qù zuò shēngyì, jiéguǒ shēngyì bù chénggōng, qián dōu méi le.
examples.english: He took all the money he had saved for half his life to do business, but the business was unsuccessful, and all the money was gone.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 我玩了整晚的手機遊戲，結果第二天差點被爸爸打一頓。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wán le zhěng wǎn de shǒujī yóuxì, jiéguǒ dì-èr tiān chàdiǎn bèi bàba dǎ yī dùn.
examples.english: I played mobile games all night, and as a result, the next day I almost got a beating from my dad.

examples.chinese: 剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？
examples.pinyin: Gānggāng dàjiā tuīlái tuīqù de, jiéguǒ bǎ píngzi gěi dǎpò le, zhè suàn shéi de cuò?
examples.english: Just now everyone was pushing it back and forth, and as a result the bottle got broken—whose fault is this considered to be?

examples.chinese: 在網路上，商品的交易雖然方便，但也應注意安全問題。許小姐知道社團網友想賣手機，就拿二手(second hand)筆電去交易，結果對方同意了。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shàng, shāngpǐn de jiāoyì suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn yě yīng zhùyì ānquán wèntí. Xǔ xiǎojiě zhīdào shètuán wǎngyǒu xiǎng mài shǒujī, jiù ná èrshǒu bǐdiàn qù jiāoyì, jiéguǒ duìfāng tóngyì le.
examples.english: Online, although product transactions are convenient, you should also pay attention to safety issues. Miss Xu knew that a club netizen wanted to sell a cell phone, so she took a second-hand laptop to trade, and the other party agreed.

examples.chinese: 有幾位學生的期中考沒考好，教授要他們下星期補考。出門上班前，我才發現短裙破了，不得不先補號再去上班，結果就遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu jǐ wèi xuéshēng de qīzhōngkǎo méi kǎo hǎo, jiàoshòu yào tāmen xià xīngqī bǔkǎo. Chūmén shàngbān qián, wǒ cái fāxiàn duǎnqún pò le, bùdébù xiān bǔ hǎo zài qù shàngbān, jiéguǒ jiù chídào le.
examples.english: Several students didn't do well on the midterm exam, so the professor wants them to take a make-up exam next week. Before going out to work, I discovered that my skirt was torn, and I had no choice but to mend it first before going to work, and as a result, I was late.

examples.chinese: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù chēhuò diàochá de jiéguǒ, bǎoxiǎn gōngsī jí duìfāng yīng gè péi wǒ shí wàn yuán.
examples.english: According to the results of the car accident investigation, the insurance company and the other party should each compensate me one hundred thousand dollars.

examples.chinese: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
examples.pinyin: A: Xìngkuī yǒu nǐ de jiànyì, tóuzī jìhuà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ, zhēn shì duōxiè nǐ le? B: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ nǔlì dédào de chéngguǒ, yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zìjǐ ba!
examples.english: A: Thanks to your suggestion, the investment plan got a very good result; thank you so much! B: Not at all, it's all the result of your own hard work; if you want to thank anyone, thank yourself!

examples.chinese: 科學家在他的時代所努力的結果，都可能會在未來開花結果。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zài tā de shídài suǒ nǔlì de jiéguǒ, dōu kěnéng huì zài wèilái kāihuā jiéguǒ.
examples.english: The results of scientists' efforts in their era may all bear fruit in the future.

examples.chinese: 一項計畫假如目標不明確，往往就得不到想要的結果。
examples.pinyin: Yí xiàng jìhuà jiǎrú mùbiāo bù míngquè, wǎngwǎng jiù dé bú dào xiǎngyào de jiéguǒ.
examples.english: If a plan's goals are not clear-cut, it often fails to achieve the desired results.

examples.chinese: 這件事大家都堅持自己的觀點，討論不出結果，還是找個說話有分量的人來決定吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dàjiā dōu jiānchí zìjǐ de guāndiǎn, tǎolùn bù chū jiéguǒ, háishì zhǎo gè shuōhuà yǒu fènliàng de rén lái juédìng ba.
examples.english: In this matter, everyone insists on their own viewpoint, and no result can be reached through discussion; it would be better to find someone whose words carry weight to decide.

examples.chinese: 期中測驗的結果明天就會公布，大家都很緊張。
examples.pinyin: Qīzhōng cèyàn de jiéguǒ míngtiān jiù huì gōngbù, dàjiā dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The results of the midterm exam will be announced tomorrow, and everyone is very nervous.

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 您想辦簽證的話，請先準備好相關證件再來辦理。
examples.pinyin: Nín xiǎng bàn qiānzhèng de huà, qǐng xiān zhǔnbèi hǎo xiāngguān zhèngjiàn zài lái bànlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to apply for a visa, please prepare the relevant documents first before coming to handle it.

examples.chinese: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn lái zhè jiā yínháng cúnkuǎn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yuángōng dōu shífēn qīnqiè. Nǐ zài bàn yīxiē guójiā de qiānzhèng shí, tāmen děi kàn nǐ de yínháng cúnkuǎn.
examples.english: I am used to coming to this bank to deposit money, because the employees here are all very friendly. When you apply for visas for some countries, they need to see your bank savings.

examples.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
examples.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

examples.chinese: 他在國外旅行時因為簽證有問題，回國時間只好提前了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài lǚxíng shí yīnwèi qiānzhèng yǒu wèntí, huíguó shíjiān zhǐhǎo tíqián le.
examples.english: While traveling abroad, because there was a problem with his visa, his return date had to be moved up.

examples.chinese: 申請簽證的表格請填完整資料，以免無法順利申請。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng de biǎogé qǐng tián wánzhěng zīliào, yǐmiǎn wúfǎ shùnlì shēnqǐng.
examples.english: Please fill out the visa application form with complete information, so as to avoid being unable to apply successfully.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

items.wordHook: Combining 擴(expand) and 大(big): 擴大 means enlarge, to expand.

examples.chinese: 她在嬰兒車上安裝了一排不同顏色的小燈，看起來很特別。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yīng'érchē shàng ānzhuāng le yì pái bùtóng yánsè de xiǎo dēng, kàn qǐlái hěn tèbié.
examples.english: She installed a row of small lights of different colors on the stroller; it looks very special.

examples.chinese: 路上安裝紅綠燈，是要保障民眾的交通安全。
examples.pinyin: Lùshàng ānzhuāng hónglǜdēng, shì yào bǎozhàng mínzhòng de jiāotōng ānquán.
examples.english: Installing traffic lights on the road is to safeguard the public's traffic safety.

examples.chinese: 算起來我們已經好久沒吃餃子了，買點兒麵粉、青菜和肉，回家包餃子吧。
examples.pinyin: Suàn qǐlái wǒmen yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi chī jiǎozi le, mǎi diǎnr miànfěn, qīngcài hé ròu, huí jiā bāo jiǎozi ba.
examples.english: Counting it up, we haven't eaten dumplings for a long time; let's buy some flour, vegetables, and meat, and go home to make dumplings.

examples.chinese: 她把蛋白拌進麵粉裡，加點兒花生烤一烤，又香又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ dànbái bàn jìn miànfěn lǐ, jiā diǎnr huāshēng kǎo yī kǎo, yòu xiāng yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: She mixed the egg white into the flour, added some peanuts, and baked it; it's fragrant and delicious.

items.wordHook: Stepping 上(above) into or toward 帝(supreme ruler): 上帝 means God, heavenly deity.
什(what) + 麼 + 時(time) + 候(time) literally means 'what time' → that's 'when?'
a 氵(water) fills with 十(ten) drops of fruit → sweet 汁(juice).
